identity.name: Neuberger Securitize High Income Tokenized Fund LTD

about.registryInfo: Neuberger Securitize High Income Tokenized Fund LTD is a British Virgin Islands corporation formed in 2026, with its registered office at Walkers Corporate, 171 Main Street, Road Town, Tortola. It filed a Form D with the SEC claiming exemptions under Rule 506(c) and section 3(c)(7) of the Investment Company Act. Securitize Capital LLC is the investment adviser and Neuberger is the subadviser.
